content.short: Indie studio making quick, casual on-chain games for Base, Farcaster, World App and more.
content.description: Trenchverse builds simple arcade and puzzle games that live inside social and wallet apps. Its ArcadeX collection includes titles such as BaseDrop, Math Run and Block Blast, while games like Clank Sort and Celo Sign are native to Farcaster and specific chains. The studio reports more than 20 live games, 2 million plays and 100,000 players, with its games also available in World App.
content.meta: Trenchverse makes quick on-chain arcade and puzzle games like BaseDrop and Block Blast, played 2M+ times.
